description:
Get a channel's (a.k.a. phone number's) webhook URL, and check if the optional webhook headers are set.

Webhook headers are optional. They can be set using the 'set_webhook' tool, which also sets the webhook URL.
When webhook headers are set, 360Dialog will send webhooks to the channel's webhook URL and add the specified headers.

This helps only authenticated requests pass through app firewalls, if the user has any.

Example:

If webhook URL is `https://foo.com/webhook`, and webhook headers are set to {"x-360dialog-webhook-security": "RANDOM-STRING"},
the webhook URL will receive POST requests like this:

POST https://foo.com/webhook
HEADERS
    x-360dialog-webhook-security: RANDOM-STRING
name: get_webhook
title: Get webhook
